payout_quote: Refer your friends and family to the credit union and both of you could earn $75. ... Referrer can refer a maximum number of 10 new members to the credit union per year. ... Incentives will be paid within 30 days of account opening after all conditions have been met.
steps: Be a current Arsenal Credit Union member (age 13+) and submit the online Member Referral Form for each friend.
Your friend establishes membership and opens qualifying accounts within 30 days of your referral submission.

Qualifying paths: (a) checking - gets a debit card, opens digital banking, and completes 5 qualifying transactions; (b) deposits - money market or CD with $2,500+ minimum deposit; (c) loans - opens a loan of any type or gets a credit card.
Your friend mentions your name at account opening; both accounts must remain open, active, and in good standing.
You and your friend each receive $75, paid within 30 days of account opening after all conditions are met.
catches: Cap: 10 new members per calendar year = max $750 in incentives.
The 30-day clock is strict: the friend must establish membership within 30 days of your referral submission or neither party gets paid.
Checking referrals require the friend to get a debit card, open digital banking, AND complete 5 qualifying transactions.
Cannot be combined with other offers; only one referral from one current Arsenal member is accepted per new member.

The official rules page (updated 5.26.2026) states the incentive is paid via direct deposit into an Arsenal savings account - older flyers mention a Visa gift card, so the current payout form is the direct-deposit version.
biggest_catch: Your friend has exactly 30 days from your referral to open and qualify - miss the window and neither of you gets the $75; and you're capped at 10 referrals per year.
eligibility: Current Arsenal Credit Union members age 13+. Referred person must be 13+ and eligible for membership; one referral per new member.
timing: Incentives paid within 30 days of account opening after all conditions have been met.
